notes: Clean, fair puzzle. Each decoy fails on exactly one thing, and the review text makes each failure clear.
The cheese/crema red herring is well done. Liam brings it up, Roxy's reaction makes her dairy issue visible, and then Liam backs down.

Dairy is framed as an intolerance (a bad breakup), so Little Comet would get 2 stars, not 0. That is fine, but a player who reads it as a strict diet might treat Little Comet as a deal-breaker. The pick is the same either way.
Tin Star's 'a few dollars more' fits its $$ card well. Willow Gate's 'sit-down restaurant prices' fits $$$.
Not too obvious: you have to read every review for the fried, dairy and price details, because all five taco cards look the same apart from the price.
